markdown:
Harbor seals are the most common seals found in Golarion and famous for their soft, furry bodies. They're vicious hunters underwater, but typically shy of humanoids on the surface, preferring to hide among the waves rather than face down what seems to be a terrifying land predator. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 16 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11 [Harbor Seal](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3305) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 178 **Perception** +9; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=371)) 20 feet, whisker sense 30 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +6, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +10, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +8 **Str** +4 **Dex** +3 **Con** +3 **Int** -4 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +3 **Deep Breath** A harbor seal can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
**Whisker Sense** A harbor seal can use its whiskers to sense vibrations as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) at the listed range, but only underwater. --- **AC** 17 **Fort** +9 **Ref** +11 **Will** +5 **HP** 30 --- **Speed** 15 feet, swim 30 feet **Melee** jaws +9, **Damage** 1d8+4 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **[Aquatic Ambush](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=51)** 40 feet **Aquatic Feast** **Requirements** The harbor seal has a Medium or smaller creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) in its jaws; **Effect** The harbor seal Swims up to 10 feet, carrying its grabbed creature along with it dealing 1d8 slashing damage (DC 18 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save).
name: Harbor Seal
